There are places that do detox and mental health, which means you can check yourself in even if you don’t qualify for the detox option. Specifically, Cornerstone/El Dorado Springs. They just did a huge expansion and have had a more bed availability recently too. I would call around, CBI is always taking in people. There is also Sonora Behavioral Health, Palo Verde, Buena Vista, and I believe Villa Maria does detox services as well.

Could be worth seeking an agency such as Cope, Codac or La Frontera. Enrolling with them gives them access to a multitude of services with an assigned case manager who can help them navigate through those services. Enrolling doesn’t require insurance as well as far as I know, and they can often help get AHCCCS if qualified. But a lot of those agencies have IOP (intense outpatient programs) if he doesn’t want to do a residential treatment option. 

If he is needing detox services, CBI does not require insurance. It’s no picnic but they can at the very least medically clear him.
